_comment: Editable interpretation corpus for Lore's natal report. Sign/planet/house names must match the app's enum names. Text is combined generatively by ChartInterpreter.

signTraits.Aries: bold, direct, and eager to lead
signTraits.Taurus: steady, sensual, and devoted to comfort and security
signTraits.Libra: charming, fair-minded, and drawn to harmony

roleFraming.Moon: Emotionally, {name} tends to be {trait}, and needs security that honours that nature.
roleFraming.Rising: To the world, {name} first comes across as {trait}.

planetThemes.Uranus: independence and the urge to break convention
planetThemes.North Node: the evolving direction of this life
planetThemes.Chiron: a core wound and the capacity to heal it

houseAreas.1: self-image and how they meet the world
houseAreas.2: resources, money, and sense of worth
houseAreas.11: friendships, groups, and hopes for the future
houseAreas.12: the unconscious, solitude, and what stays hidden

aspectNotes.Conjunction: These energies blend and amplify each other.
aspectNotes.Sextile: An easy, supportive link that offers opportunity when used.
aspectNotes.Square: Friction here pushes growth through effort and challenge.
aspectNotes.Trine: A natural, effortless flow of talent between the two.
aspectNotes.Opposition: A push-pull that seeks balance between opposite needs.

elements.Fire: a fiery temperament — driven, enthusiastic, and quick to act
elements.Earth: an earthy temperament — practical, grounded, and reliable
elements.Air: an airy temperament — intellectual, social, and idea-driven
elements.Water: a watery temperament — emotional, intuitive, and empathetic
